verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has alarms with configurable thresholds and anomaly detection for error-volume spikes, plus auto-resolve on deploy, which map loosely to spike-protection and reducing noise—but there is no documented per-key rate limiting or explicit mute/ignore rule feature akin to Sentry's alert fatigue tools. missing for 10: explicit per-key/per-error rate limiting, dedicated mute/ignore/snooze rules, and evidence these prevent mass paging during a bad deploy.
